other: GSE130261 (SuperSeries of the RNA-seq and bisulfite-seq subseries)

study_summary.objective: Check whether A. oryzae has DNA methylation, a point earlier work on Aspergillus disputed; this BioProject holds the RNA-seq half (bisulfite-seq is in a sibling series), from the GEO/BioProject text.
study_summary.experimental_design: RIB40 grown in liquid CD-Glc medium or on solid wheat bran, 3 biological replicates each; each library was sequenced as 6 SRA runs and only the first run of each is in the atlas.
study_summary.main_finding: Not available: no accession-linked paper was found, so no result is reported here.

tags.note: 'WB' in the sample title read as wheat bran

notes: Medium abbreviations in the GEO sample titles (CD-Glc, WB) are read here as Czapek-Dox with glucose and wheat bran; temperature and time are not stated.
Each library has 6 SRA runs (r1 to r6); only r1 was processed, giving about 4 M read pairs and 3.2 M gene-assigned counts per sample, shallow compared with the rest of the atlas.
